description: Products from any Shopify store: prices, sale prices, discounts, stock, variants, SKUs, images and descriptions. Whole stores, collections or single products. Useful for price and stock monitoring. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/shopify-products on your Apify account (about $0.001 per product; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

keywords.description: Only products matching any of these words.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

only_available.description: Only products that are in stock.

only_on_sale.description: Only products with a sale price.

stores.description: Store domains, collection links or product links, e.g. "allbirds.com".

name: get_shopify_products

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get products from Shopify stores
